notes.title: Music change and bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed one of the songs that induced anxiety instead of calmness
[*] Fixed a possible crash when backing out of the custom levels menu
[*] Updated the json library to a newer version
[/list]

notes.title: Puzzle reset button and better drop point contrast.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Drop points are now black instead of white to contrast against the floor.
[*] Added a full reset button to start a puzzle over without having to exit and re-enter the level.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed a stutter with lower framerates
notes.content:
Fixed a severe stutter with player movement on lower framerates
Note: The robot still stutters a bit on lower framerates, but it should be much better now.

Fixed a bug with Steam achievements when the game is unable to connect to Steamworks
